Provide all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to supply and install the complete electrical system in accordance with the Owner’s Scope of Work dated Wednesday, December 3, 2025, the referenced construction documents, the National Electrical Code, and all applicable local codes and authorities having jurisdiction.
Included Scope:
• PECO temporary service application and associated fees
• Temporary power outlets on all floors
• Temporary lighting in stairwells and hallways to maintain a safe, well-lit site
• Complete PECO vault room scope including coring, grounding, lighting, receptacles per PECO specs, cable ladder, secondary wiring from transformers to main service and house service
• Supply and installation of breakers and panelboards for all apartment units
• Electrical services from the main electrical room to individual apartments
• Exit and emergency lighting, including 5” LED surface fixtures in apartment hallways and stairwells (excluding
basement and garage areas)
• Complete fire alarm wiring and system installation per approved drawings
• RG6 cabling from apartment units to telecommunications closet on same floor
• Electrical permit acquisition and electrical inspection fees
Exclusions
• Decorative lighting fixtures of any type
• Basement and garage normal and emergency lighting
• (2) 1200A main disconnects and metering for the 74 apartment units
• House CT cabinet, house main panel, and breakers for house panels
• Media boxes within dwelling units
• Micro-duct conduit and wiring to dwelling units
• Cable company primary infrastructure and terminations

EV Charger (Installation Only)
- Supply and install 2-pole 60 Amp branch circuit breaker in existing main panel.
- Supply and install 60A/240V dedicated circuit using copper conductors from main panel to exterior rear wall of home.
Run 6/2 armored cable along basement surface and convert to PVC conduit on exterior of house.
Circuit to be concealed in PVC conduit where exposed on the side and rear of home. 
- Mount EV charger on exterior rear wall of converted garage near driveway.  
- Terminate all wiring within main electrical panel and EV charger.
- Energize and test charging station and identify circuit in main panel.

- Supply and install Leviton single-phase, 120/240 volt NEMA-1 Surge Protection Devices, one for each main breaker panel.
- Supply a dedicated 240 volt, 20 amp circuit mounted at the top of the buss.
- Energize and test.

PANEL MAINTENANCE AND CLEANING
- Blow out panel debris.
- Clean off all contacts.
- Ensure all connections are tight.
- Inspect and test arc fault circuit breakers (AFCI)
- Inspect and test ground fault circuit breakers (GFCI)
- Note and report any deficiencies.

Electrical Permit
- All Phase to apply for township permit and coordinate inspection via third party electrical underwriter.

EZ PERMIT STANDARDS ALTERATIONS
For alterations to an Existing One Family Dwelling as per attached standard. Deviations from this standard will result in permit revocation and require submission of construction plans. STRUCTURAL ALTERATION OR REPAIR IS EXPRESSLY PROHIBITED UNDER THIS PERMIT.  PROHIBITED STRUCTURAL WORK INCLUDES ANY MODIFICATION TO EXTERIOR WALLS, PARTY WALLS, FLOOR/ROOF FRAMING OR FOUNDATIONS, UNDERPINNING AND EXCAVATIONS (I.E. DIGGING IN BASEMENT). ANY WORK/ALTERATIONS TO THE BASEMENT/CELLAR IS EXPRESSLY PROHIBITED UNLESS DOCUMENTED AS AN EXISTING HABITABLE SPACE WITH HEIGHTS AND MEANS OF EGRESS PER CONDITIONS OF THE EZ STANDARD. Separate permits required for Mechanical, Electric and Plumbing, ETC.
*NO BASEMENT ALTERATIONS OF ANY KIND WERE PROPOSED OR APPROVED FOR THIS PERMIT*
*NO STRUCTURAL ALTERATIONS OF ANY KIND WERE PROPOSED OR APPROVED FOR THIS PERMIT*
The project consists of repairs that restore the dwelling to the original design intent, specifically framing interior walls on both the 1st & 2nd floor as well as the existing finished basement, new kitchen with new counter-tops, cabinets, and tile floor, remodeling and tiling of existing bathrooms, overlaying 1/2" gypsum wallboard throughout the property, replacement of all (10) windows, spackling and painting of all drywall surfaces, and replacement of exterior trim and downspouts, and is NOT considered a structural modification. The existing basement is finished and includes a laundry room, bathroom, open habitable space, storage area, and access to the garage as well as an egress door to an open area. A clear ceiling height of 7’ will remain with drywall attached directly to joists. No structural work will be performed in any area of the dwelling.
